newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Binghamton, N.Y.

text.p: at Hawkins, Delafield & Wood, 67 Wall Street, New York, New
Bonds dated May 15, 1997, interest March 15 and September 15 each year commencing March 15, 1998. Bonds mature in principal installments on March 15 as follows:
Bids, accompanied by $208,465.60 good faith deposit check, must be for all $10,423,280 bonds. Award shall be based on net interest cost.

Bidders must refer to the full Notice of Sale for the complete terms and conditions of the sale. Copies of said Notice and the Official Statement may be promptly obtained from Fiscal Advisors & Marketing, Inc., Cicero Professional Building, Suite 112, 6221 Route 31, Cicero, New York 13039, telephone number (315) 699-7912; fax (315) 699-8833.
